<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Organisation" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>file</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>feedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="service" name="Customer service">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>log</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>assign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>resolve</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="dept" name="Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>review</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>notify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>approved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="finance" name="Financial team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>reimburse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Complaint needed" />
    <bpmn:task id="file" name="File the complaint" />
    <bpmn:task id="log" name="Log the complaint" />
    <bpmn:task id="assign" name="Assign the complaint to the relevant department" />
    <bpmn:task id="review" name="Review the details and determine the decision" />
    <bpmn:task id="notify" name="Notify the customer with the decision" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="approved" name="Refund approved?" />
    <bpmn:task id="reimburse" name="Process the reimbursement" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="merge" />
    <bpmn:task id="resolve" name="Mark the complaint as resolved" />
    <bpmn:task id="feedback" name="Provide feedback on satisfaction" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Complaint closed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="file" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="file" targetRef="log" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="log" targetRef="assign" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="assign" targetRef="review" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="review" targetRef="notify" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="notify" targetRef="approved" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" name="yes" sourceRef="approved" targetRef="reimburse" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" name="no" sourceRef="approved" targetRef="merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="reimburse" targetRef="merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="merge" targetRef="resolve" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="resolve" targetRef="feedback" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="feedback" targetRef="end" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
